evidence: EntityPath::new rejects only empty/whitespace segments and joins with '/'; parse splits on '/'. World::rename_node in scene/world/records.rs accepts a slash, and World::entity_path in scene/world/property_access/path_resolution.rs calls new with that name.
impact_or_question: A node named A/B has one structured path segment, but its string representation reparses as two; external animation/property references cannot reliably roundtrip it.
next_action: Specify escaping or reject separators at the world naming boundary, then add a world-path roundtrip test.

evidence: scene/reflect/dynamic_component.rs constructs ComponentPropertyPath::new(type_path, field) with dotted type paths. ComponentPropertyPath::parse splits a text path at the first dot, while scene/world/compiled_binding/compiled_scene_dynamic_field.rs splits at the last dot.
impact_or_question: A dynamic component path changes component identity after as_str/parse. Clarify whether parse is for built-in paths only or the text grammar must support dynamic type paths.
next_action: Document the intended path grammar and add roundtrip/caller tests before changing parsing or encoding.

evidence: AxisLimitsVisitor::visit_map checks limits[index].is_some() before map.next_value(); a first JSON axis value null deserializes as None, so repeated x or alias 0 passes. The existing scene/physics/tests.rs duplicate test covers only a non-null first value.
impact_or_question: Malformed duplicate axis entries can be accepted and the later value replaces the first, contrary to the tested duplicate-key rejection contract.
next_action: Track seen keys separately from optional values and test null plus duplicate canonical/alias axis keys.

evidence: SoundPlaybackCompletionAction includes DespawnEntity and RemoveAudioComponents. zircon_plugins/sound/runtime/src/service_types/sources.rs and engine/state/playback.rs only append the action to finished events. A first-party Rust call-site scan found no non-test drain_finished_sources/playbacks consumer.
impact_or_question: The owner that performs requested ECS mutations is unclear; these variants may currently be report-only.
next_action: Define the scene-side consumer or narrow the completion-action contract, then add a lifecycle test.

evidence: DefaultSoundManager::render_mix_impl in zircon_plugins/sound/runtime/src/service_types/runtime_settings.rs and manual output methods in service_types/output_render.rs always return UnsupportedAdvancedFeature because Kira owns callbacks.
impact_or_question: Public SoundMixRenderManager and manual output-pull methods advertise capabilities unavailable from the default registered implementation.
next_action: Decide whether to retire these methods or specify an alternate implementation and capability negotiation.

evidence: zircon_plugins/sound/runtime/src/service_types/runtime_settings.rs:set_default_spatial_scale_impl writes only SoundConfig.default_spatial_scale. A first-party Rust search finds no read of this field outside its getter/config constructor. engine/source_environment/apply.rs accepts a fallback spatial_scale, but apply_source_environment has no runtime caller.
impact_or_question: Setting the public default spatial scale reports success but does not affect active source processing or output.
next_action: Wire the default through the active source/backend path or reject unsupported mutation; add an audible spatial behavior regression test.
